Recommended Mystic Skills
=========================

.. list-table::
   :header-rows: 1

   * - Name
     - Icon
     - Usage
   * - **Flaming Meteor**
     - .. image:: /_static/{32D81D2D-8C77-4078-A1F8-FC291B80D058}.png
     - Can delete healers fast. How to use: **Target Lock** Healer, enemies will naturally gather around healer so you will hit more and the more you hit the harder the skill hits
   * - **Ghost Bind**
     - .. image:: /_static/{39794CFB-E5DC-4E45-8034-E6C01A58F473}.png
     - Speeds up clearing neutral camps (must have for **T3**)
   * - **Lion's Roar**
     - .. image:: /_static/{8CCAB359-82B2-4C20-A7FD-3873E70A6264}.png
     - AoE Damage plus **SILENCE**
   * - **Leaping Toad**
     - .. image:: /_static/{4905D25F-13D1-4A46-963F-C82C3CE74D90}.png
     - **Inflict venom** before using Lion's Roar for more damage (first jump inflicts venom)

.. toctree::
